claims.assertion: Mari says a nighttime attack on Taygetan settlers on Procyon killed 45; three survived, and the disaster is taught as a colonization warning.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She blames poor biological study and a fragile camp.

claims.assertion: Mari identifies the attackers as Gunabul, reptilian apex predators that hunt at night and remain a threat in restricted areas.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She speculates that Reptilians introduced them.
